definition: Ten nearest countries among the family-specific documented-history universe; country of origin excluded. Chosen by distance, never by growth or model coefficients. Histories outside this universe are not imputed.
reason: Reference-style learning assumes observable peer adoption states. A full-world network mixed observed countries with unknown histories. Both network definitions and the failed strict joint models are retained.
caution: The register is retrospectively observed and selected. This is a documented-history peer-network adaptation, not a reproduction of the original 168-country IFRS panel.
